conventions.commits: Conventional commits with scope and PR number, e.g. 'feat(core): add Swift language support with tree-sitter-swift handler (#1742)'. Commits are GPG-signed (gpgsig header present on 132ea68 and dbc2971) and carry a 'Signed-off-by: Hugues Clouatre' DCO trailer.
conventions.testing: Unit tests live in-file under #[cfg(test)] mod tests in each languages/*.rs (queries_compile, element match, inheritance happy and empty paths, defuse write). Table tests in languages/mod.rs and lang.rs. Integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs (analyze_file on tempfile) and crates/aptu-coder/tests/*.rs using common::call_tool_raw.
conventions.linting: cargo clippy --locked --profile ci -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check; cargo deny check advisories licenses bans; REUSE compliance. Workspace lints deny unwrap_used, expect_used and undocumented_unsafe_blocks (test code exempted via cfg_attr).
conventions.error_handling: Handlers return Option or Vec and never panic on missing nodes: child_by_field_name followed by and_then, get_node_text bounds check, u32::try_from(i).unwrap_or(u32::MAX) for named_child indices. Query compile errors surface as ParserError from parser.rs (line 161 region).

patterns: Per-language handler file with SPDX header, pub const ELEMENT_QUERY / CALL_QUERY / REFERENCE_QUERY / IMPORT_QUERY / DEFUSE_QUERY, and optional handler fns (java.rs, swift.rs).
Registry in languages/mod.rs: one LanguageInfo arm in get_language_info plus one arm in get_ts_language; Option fields set to None where a feature is absent (fortran uses defuse_query: None).
Extension lookup in lang.rs EXTENSION_MAP as (ext, lang) tuples; supported_languages() list gates QUERY_CACHE and the analyze error message.

Capture-name contract: 'function'/'class' with func_name|method_name|class_name|type_name; calls use 'call'; imports 'import_path'; references 'type_ref'; defuse uses 'write.*', 'read.*', 'writeread.*' prefixes.
Inheritance: named-child walks with kind guards, output strings prefixed 'extends ' / 'implements ' (java.rs, swift.rs 'conforms').
Latest language addition (#1742 Swift) touched Cargo.lock, root Cargo.toml, core Cargo.toml, lang.rs, languages/mod.rs and one new handler file.
Lazy per-language query compilation (#1786) means adding a language costs nothing at startup unless used.

constraints: Issue body: the maintainers are implementing this in-house and external pull requests are not accepted. This Scout output is for internal planning only.

Acceptance criteria require tree-sitter-php in the root [workspace.dependencies] and in crates/aptu-coder-core/Cargo.toml, with Cargo.lock updated, and cargo deny passing without SKIP_PACKAGE_AGE_CHECK.

New Cargo.lock entries must be at least 7 days old (AGENTS.md). Crate 0.25.2 tag date is 2026-11-19 (8 days before today); 0.25.1 (2026-10-06) is the safer fallback. crates.io publish date was not verifiable via gh.

Issue scope: no extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver or find_receiver_type; no trait use resolution, property or constant extraction, attributes, or namespace alias import; no .phtml/.inc/.module/.php5 extensions; no tool-handler or schema change.
Mixed HTML and <?php files must parse with zero ERROR nodes: use LANGUAGE_PHP, which accepts text outside php tags; LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY does not.
Workspace lints deny unwrap_used, expect_used and undocumented_unsafe_blocks; no unsafe code in the handler.
README links must stay absolute (AGENTS.md); the README supported list must add PHP.

Schema pattern (schema_helpers) is derived from supported_extensions(), so adding ('php','php') to EXTENSION_MAP automatically updates it; the existing test checks every extension matches case-insensitively.
test_coverage: No PHP tests exist (expected). Affected areas: lang.rs has extension happy-path and edge tests plus a schema-pattern test over all EXTENSION_MAP entries; languages/mod.rs has a table test (test_get_language_info_covers_remaining_registered_languages) that checks name, reference_query, import_query and get_ts_language for each listed language; java.rs and swift.rs have inline tests for queries_compile, element match, inheritance and defuse; css.rs tests element and import queries only; integration_tests.rs covers Java parse and inheritance via analyze_file. Parser lazy-compile test (parser.rs ~1040-1062) depends on supported_languages().len().

approaches.name: A: Full-scope handler mirroring java.rs and swift.rs (recommended)
approaches.description: Mirror java.rs and swift.rs in one new file crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/php.rs using tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP (not LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY, because the issue requires mixed HTML files). Queries validated in a scratch crate against tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 and tree-sitter 0.27.2 with zero ERROR nodes on the sample. ELEMENT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY: see the query fields. CALL_QUERY (validated, captures 'call' per parser_elements.rs:496): (function_call_expression   function: (name) @call) (function_call_expression   function: (qualified_name (name) @call)) (member_call_expression   name: (name) @call) (nullsafe_member_call_expression   name: (name) @call) (scoped_call_expression   name: (name) @call) REFERENCE_QUERY (validated, captures 'type_ref'): (named_type (name) @type_ref) IMPORT_QUERY (validated, captures 'import_path'; the '.' anchor is required, otherwise the alias name of 'Arr as A' is also captured): (namespace_use_clause . [(qualified_name) (name)] @import_path) extract_inheritance per inheritance_walk_citation. Wire lang.rs (EXTENSION_MAP, supported_languages), languages/mod.rs (pub mod php, get_language_info arm, get_ts_language arm, test table) and the Cargo manifests plus Cargo.lock. Add unit tests in php.rs and an integration test in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs; README line 55 and the intro count in mod.rs line 7 both need PHP.
pros: Covers every acceptance criterion in the issue, including the HTML template and inheritance no-clause cases
Queries validated in a scratch build against the exact crate versions
Mirrors the Swift six-file wiring and the Java inheritance contract
Keeps mod.rs and lang.rs changes to single arms and single lines
cons: Larger than a minimal integration: five queries plus an inheritance walk
Import module names drop the group prefix for 'use A\\{B, C}' (B and C come out bare); a known limitation not in the issue scope
Alias imports are not resolved (issue scope excludes them)
Crate age check may need 0.25.1 if the 0.25.2 publish date is under 7 days

approaches.name: B: Minimal set without DEFUSE_QUERY
approaches.description: Same php.rs but defuse_query: None in the LanguageInfo arm, as fortran.rs does (fortran sets defuse_query: None in mod.rs). Element, call, reference, import and inheritance only.
cons: Does not match the issue scope, which lists DEFUSE_QUERY among the five required query constants
parser_elements.rs returns early when compiled.defuse is None, so define-use queries return nothing for PHP
Would need a follow-up issue to meet the stated scope

approaches.name: C: PHP_ONLY grammar with regex fallback for HTML
approaches.description: Use tree_sitter_php::LANGUAGE_PHP_ONLY for the parser and strip non-PHP text before parsing; or add a regex pre-pass for the template case instead of relying on LANGUAGE_PHP text nodes.
pros: Parser has no text nodes for template content
Smaller query surface because text nodes are excluded
cons: Pre-processing changes line numbers and byte offsets unless padded carefully
Adds a second code path not present for any other language
Violates the spirit of the acceptance criterion that the HTML case yields the same elements as the PHP-only file via the same grammar
LANGUAGE_PHP already handles the template case per the grammar's test_php_grammar and the scratch parse (error_nodes=0)

recommendation: Approach A. It is the only option that meets the issue acceptance criteria as written: it uses LANGUAGE_PHP so HTML templates parse with zero ERROR nodes (verified: has_error=false on a mixed sample), it includes DEFUSE_QUERY (required by the issue's query list and by parser_elements.rs define-use consumers), and it follows the java.rs and swift.rs contracts. Approach B is a valid fallback only if the maintainers drop DEFUSE_QUERY from scope. Approach C adds complexity without a benefit, since LANGUAGE_PHP already handles the template case.

inheritance_walk_citation: Source: tree-sitter-php grammar rules in common/define-grammar.js (php/grammar.js is a stub that calls defineGrammar('php') from ../common/define-grammar.js); node-types in php/src/node-types.json. Walk, as verified in a scratch run against tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 (LANGUAGE_PHP), on the class `abstract class Animal extends Base implements Speaker, \Countable { ... }`: (1) class_declaration has NO superclass or interfaces field; its node-types fields are only attributes, body (declaration_list) and name (name). (2) Grammar: class_declaration = prec.right(seq(optional(attributes), repeat(_modifier), keyword('class'), field('name', reserved('classes', $.name)), optional($.base_clause), optional($.class_interface_clause), field('body', $.declaration_list))). (3) extends = the unnamed child of kind base_clause, grammar base_clause = seq(keyword('extends'), commaSep1($._name)); its named children are name | qualified_name | relative_name (node-types children list). Verified: base_clause -> name:Base. (4) implements = the unnamed child of kind class_interface_clause, grammar class_interface_clause = seq(keyword('implements'), commaSep1($._name)); same child kinds. Verified: class_interface_clause -> name:Speaker, qualified_name:\Countable. Handler walk: iterate class_declaration.children(), match kind 'base_clause' -> push 'extends {text}' for each named child; match kind 'class_interface_clause' -> push 'implements {text}' per named child; read text via get_node_text bounds check. Edge: a qualified name keeps its leading backslash (\Countable) in the text. interface_declaration uses the same base_clause child for multiple 'extends' names (grammar: optional($.base_clause)); enum_declaration uses class_interface_clause for implements and primitive_type for the backing type. Name field walk: child_by_field_name('name') -> name node; text sliced from source.
